messages:
maya: Quick sync — ACME asks for per-tenant per-route SLO controls. They want canary + per-tenant routing at launch. Do we expand scope or ship a lighter tier?
chris: What's the delta to ship? rough estimate?
dani: Core change is routing policy enforcement in control plane + console UI. ballpark 6 sprints for full parity.
sam: Sales: ACME is explicit about SLA and will pay for dedicated work if we commit to a 3mo timeline. they see competitor momentum.
chris: Options: A) Full parity (6 sprints, enterprise-priced). B) v1-lite (2 sprints: feature flag + docs). C) Dedicated-only shim (3 sprints) for committed customers.
maya: Important: XCorp announced tenant routing preview today — risk of churn if we stall.
dani: My leaning: do C (Dedicated shim) immediately, ship v1-lite to hosted as minimum, backlog full parity for Q4.
sam: :thumbsup: C -> v1-lite -> parity sounds defensible. sales must secure funding for C.
chris: Resource impacts: 1 infra eng for 6 weeks, 1 backend, UI designer, QA. I'll validate with infra.
maya: Launch criteria for C: routing shim deployed, routing policy doc, pilot with 2 customers, telemetry + rollback plan.
dani: Recommend canary at 5% traffic, automated regression test for latency/token-peek.
product-bot: Reminder: create JIRA ticket PROJ-7423 and link ACME contract notes.
sam: I'll spin up PO and loop in @legal for SLA language.
maya: Next steps: chris confirm resource estimate by EOD; dani draft scope doc; sam confirm funding. Sync Wed 10am.
chris: noted—EOD estimate incoming.
dani: drafting now, will post a short spec and checklist.
sam: PO started. ping me for customer perf targets.
maya: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the decision record. :spiral_calendar:

```rollout
- stage 1: deploy shim to Dedicated pool (pilot tenants)
- stage 2: telemetry + 5% canary
- stage 3: expand to committed customers
- stage 4: document + billing updates
```
